_readme: Visible-slice checks (COLLECTION.md s7 A/B pass and s8 duty 1), recorded as they are made, 2026-09-26; each entry is the priced event the row's figure rests on, with its citation.

Anthropic.note: confidential IPO filing 2026-06-01; not listed as of 2026-09-26 (listing expected Oct-Nov 2026). Point Nine entered at the Feb 2026 $30B Series G at $380B.

Revolut.event: company-run secondary share sale at $115B (employees selling), confirmed by Bloomberg 2026-07-22; the Nov 2025 sale was at $75B, the last primary the 2021 Series E at $33B
Revolut.note: a tender, treated as a mark as a16z and Greylock treated the $75B one; crosses into 100b_plus, so rule 10 against a16z and Greylock (both $75B, 10b_plus) needs alignment at close

Contentful.event: Salesforce signed a definitive agreement 2026-06-01 and completed the acquisition 2026-09-01; price undisclosed (The Information: roughly $1-1.5B, against the 2021 $3B round)
Contentful.note: closing reported 2026-09-01 (search summary); the site already reads Acquired

Clio.event: $500M Series G at $5B post-money led by NEA, with the $1B vLex acquisition

Odyssey.event: $310M Series B at $1.45B led by Natural Capital (Amazon, GV, AMD Ventures, EQT, IQT)
Odyssey.note: Point Nine's site entry 'Later-stage 2026'; confirm Point Nine is named in the Series B. Homonyms in sibling books: a16z's Odyssey (K-12 ESA platform) and USV's Odyssey (energy finance) are different companies.

Poolside.event: Nvidia paid $6B to license Poolside's Model Factory (and hired 100+ engineers) and invested $1B for a stake valuing the company at $12B; the Oct 2025 $2B round at $12B had fallen apart (FT, April 2026)
Poolside.note: the company continues (acqui-hire rule: the company decides the status); Felicis carries $12B (10b_plus), Redpoint $3B from Oct 2024 (1b_plus) is the stale side for rule 10

Mambu.event: EUR 235M Series E at EUR 4.9B post-money led by EQT Growth
Mambu.note: convert at the ECB rate of the announcement date (fx-convert.py); stale

Docplanner.event: round valuing the business at USD 1bn
Docplanner.note: at the band edge; stale; Jan 2026 $33.8M raise with no disclosed valuation

Algolia.note: sibling books' pinned mark (accel / battery / creandum), reused for rule-10 consistency; citation to re-open in the A/B pass

Preply.event: $150M Series D at $1.2B led by WestCap

NexHealth.event: $125M Series C at $1B led by Buckley Ventures
NexHealth.note: band edge (within 5% of $1B); stale beyond 24 months

Delivery Hero.event: market cap EUR 11.19B on Frankfurt (XETRA: DHER); Uber takeover offer at EUR 41.50 per share pending
Delivery Hero.note: public until an Uber deal closes (a signed but unclosed acquisition is a mark, not a status change); convert the EUR cap at the ECB rate of the as-of date; confirm the offer terms in the A/B pass

Marley Spoon.event: 468 SPAC II SE (renamed Marley Spoon Group SE, Frankfurt) took 84% through a business combination and tender; Marley Spoon SE delisted from the ASX 2024-08
Marley Spoon.note: IPO'd-then-acquired with a successor entity: acquired + note (COLLECTION.md s6)

Tier.event: TIER merged with Dott (announced Jan 2024 with a EUR 60M investment from existing shareholders; completed 2024-10-02); the combined company trades as Dott, EBITDA-positive in FY2025, EUR 85M raised via a Nordic bond and a Series D extension
Tier.note: below_1b on collapse evidence: Tier's EUR 2B 2021 mark fell to about EUR 150M in the merger (Dealroom's figure, vendor, note only); the Point Nine position continues in the merged company, which the job board lists as Dott
